about: Cases for the rule that a run of extra words says the script beside it again (issue #2251 item 30). The sidecar (recording_coverage.repeat_of) and the Editing page (duplicates.ts saysScriptAgain) must both answer `repeat` for each. `script` is one line; `prev` and `next` are the indexes of the script words heard just before and just after the run, null at either end. Words are plain lower case: each side's own normalisation is tested beside it.
